page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c4g1.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the ecs.gn5 family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated physical cores with 8 vCPUs, operating at a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio. The instance is configured with 60.0 GB of system memory, providing 7.5 GB of RAM per core.

This server is equipped with two NVIDIA P100 graphics processing units, delivering a combined total of 32 GB of VRAM. For local storage, the instance includes a bundled 944 GB SSD. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 5 Gbps.

Given the dual-GPU configuration and dedicated CPU allocation, this instance is designed for GPU-accelerated workloads such as deep learning training, high-performance computing, and parallel processing tasks. The inclusion of local SSD storage and 60.0 GB of RAM supports data-intensive operations, though the lack of hyperthreading limits concurrent CPU-bound threads. The hardware profile offers a balanced resource density for workloads requiring dedicated hardware acceleration and local high-speed storage.
